text:
maria-peopleops: Heads up — we've published an update to the Employee Handbook (Leave & Time-off section) clarifying parental leave eligibility for contractors and part-time employees. Please review and complete the short acknowledgment + 10-min microtraining by Fri 2026-04-03. Link: https://handbook.redwood.com/leave/parental-update

sam-engineering: Quick question — does this change the accrual for existing PT folks or only new hires?

maria-peopleops: Good Q. It's clarifying eligibility and pay parity for employees on payroll; for contractors we added an opt-in benefit for those on 1099 with at least 12mo continuous engagement. PT employees will be prorated based on FTE. Details in the handbook page.

alex-manager: Is manager training mandatory? I need to cascade to my ICs.

maria-peopleops: Manager microtraining is required for all people managers (10–15 min). ICs only need the acknowledgment + 10-min course. We'll auto-assign via LMS (link below). We'll send roster to all managers tomorrow.

jamie-hr-bot: Reminder scheduled — microtraining assignments will be sent at 09:00 PT tomorrow. :bell:

li-devex: Can we get a short blurb for team offsites? Our managers get a lot of questions.

maria-peopleops: Yep — draft blurb attached: "We've updated parental leave eligibility and added a short manager training. All employees, please review the handbook page and complete the acknowledgment before Apr 3." I'll post to #general and email.

sam-engineering: Thanks. Also, is there a grace period if someone is on leave and the policy change lands?

maria-peopleops: No retroactive changes to leaves already in progress. New policy applies to leaves starting after the effective date (2026-04-01). We'll update the FAQ on the page.

alex-manager: Thx. I'll tell my team to watch for the LMS email.

maria-peopleops: TY — ping me if you see any edge cases. cc @jamie-hr-bot

jamie-hr-bot: Acknowledged. Creating manager roster now.

li-devex: :thumbsup:
